title: Example 3 – Timer: PWM and pulse (compare), key press duration (capture)
description: 4 LEDs on port L, 4 push buttons on port M. LED1 = PWM from Timer0 (T0CCP0), LED2 = pulse from Timer1 (T1CCP0), key 0 on T2CCP0 (Timer2 capture), UART0
_pins: LED1/LED2 and key 0 are on CCP pins (GPIOPCTL = 3): PL4 = T0CCP0, PL6 = T1CCP0, PM0 = T2CCP0

uart.label: UART0 (PA0 RX / PA1 TX) – level and key press duration

solution.label: Demo (Timer0 PWM, Timer1 pulse, Timer2 capture)

scope._timebaseUs: 20 ms/div: about 6 PWM periods; for the 1 s pulse of LED2 choose 200 ms/div in the web console
